en.answer: In this situation, if the effect of your <<5737>> is applying, but your opponent Special Summons a new monster, that monster must also attack the monster that was targeted by <<5737>>.
en.question: During my opponent's Battle Phase, if the effect of my <<5737>> is applying, but my opponent activates <<4989>> and Special Summons a new monster, does that monster also have to attack the monster that was targeted with <<5737>>?
en.title: During my opponent's Battle Phase, if the effect of my <<5737>> is applying, but my opponent activates <<4989>> and Special Summons a new monster, does that monster also have to attack the monster that was targeted with <<5737>>?

ja.answer: 質問の状況のように、自分の発動した「<<5737>>」の効果が適用されている相手ターンのバトルフェイズにて、相手が新たなモンスターを特殊召喚した場合には、そのモンスターも「<<5737>>」が発動された際に選択されたモンスターを対象に攻撃を行わなければなりません。
